retrievalProfile.description: A celestial-themed pop aesthetic featuring a large moon backdrop, dark foreground subjects, and a mix of elegant script and wide-spaced sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: Two central figures in dark attire posed in front of a massive, detailed full moon that fills the frame, accented by elegant white typography and decorative flourishes in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects centered and layered in front of a large circular moon
High contrast between dark clothing and bright lunar surface
Typography positioned at the top, overlapping the moon's upper edge
Decorative filigree framing the primary artist name
coreInvariants: Large detailed moon as the primary background element
Dark, desaturated color palette for the foreground
White typography for maximum legibility against dark space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects are crouched in the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fit within the diameter of the moon.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright full moon acts as the primary visual anchor and light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright typography at the top, move down to the faces of the subjects, and settle on the dark foreground textures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black sky in the corners provides negative space for decorative flourishes and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark charcoal (background and clothing)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and blonde hair highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the moon and the dark surroundings.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses a high-contrast serif with custom swashes
Secondary title uses a geometric sans-serif with extreme letter spacing
Thin stroke weights to maintain elegance
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is integrated into the flow of the serif letters
Extended flourishes on the initial and terminal letters of the top line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a decorative, flourished serif and a clean, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar wide-set geometric feel for the subtitle
Captures the flourished serif aesthetic of the main title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast image of two blonde women in dark clothing crouched in front of a massive, detailed full moon that fills the frame against a black sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a white flourished serif font at the top left with decorative scrolls. Add the secondary title in a white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif centered below it.

verificationChecks: Is the moon the dominant background element?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough to span the moon's width?
Are the decorative flourishes present in the top corners?

mustRedesign: Ensure flourishes are original vector art

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subjects and moon

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between text and background
Verify the moon is perfectly circular
Ensure the wide tracking is consistent across the subtitle
Confirm the flourishes do not obscure the faces
recipe.reuseFormula: Large lunar backdrop + dark-clad subjects + wide-tracked sans-serif + flourished serif accents.
